t: Essentials Wood Grade 000 Ultra Fine Steel Wool is designed for effective cleaning and polishing of wood surfaces. This extra fine grade steel wool, specifically Grade 000, prepares wood thoroughly prior to refinishing, ensuring a smooth and professional finish. Ideal for joiners and carpenters working on furniture restoration or new installations, its ultra fine grit type removes imperfections without scratching. The 150g pack provides ample material, and it can be easily cut to size with scissors for precise application in various woodworking tasks.
